subtasks.title: Implement workspace path resolution in apikit Load()
details: In apikit's config Load() function, resolve cfg.Workspace.Path using the same resolveDataPath logic as cfg.Database.Path

Resolution rules: (1) path with directory component used as-is; (2) bare name + XDG_DATA_HOME → $XDG_DATA_HOME/<name>; (3) empty + XDG_DATA_HOME → $XDG_DATA_HOME/workspaces; (4) empty + no XDG_DATA_HOME → ./data/workspaces
Default cfg.Workspace.Workers to 4 if the value is 0 or omitted after loading

subtasks.title: Implement job queue type and worker pool startup
details: Create internal/workspace/queue.go defining a CloneJob struct with fields: WorkspaceSlug string, GitURL string, Branch *string, JobType string ("clone" or "reclone")
Define a Queue struct backed by a buffered chan CloneJob with capacity proportional to Workers
Implement NewQueue(ctx context.Context, workers int, db *sql.DB, workspaceRoot string) *Queue that starts workers goroutines consuming from the channel
On context cancellation, workers exit their select loop and pending jobs are discarded

subtasks.title: Implement clone worker execution logic
details: In internal/workspace/clone.go, implement func executeCloneJob(ctx context.Context, job CloneJob, db *sql.DB, workspaceRoot string) error
Step 1: UPDATE workspaces SET clone_status='cloning', updated_at=<now> WHERE slug=job.WorkspaceSlug
Step 2: Check if <workspaceRoot>/<slug> already exists; if so, set clone_status='ready' and return (idempotency)
Step 3: os.MkdirAll(<workspaceRoot>/<slug>, 0755)
Step 4: Build CloneOptions{URL: job.GitURL, Depth: 1}; if job.Branch != nil, set SingleBranch=true, ReferenceName=plumbing.NewBranchReferenceName(*job.Branch)
Step 5: Call git.PlainCloneContext(ctx, <workspaceRoot>/<slug>/trunk, false, &opts)
Step 6 success: read HEAD SHA via repo.Head().Hash().String(); UPDATE workspaces SET clone_status='ready', head_sha=<sha>, clone_error=NULL, updated_at=<now>
Step 6 failure: os.RemoveAll(<workspaceRoot>/<slug>); UPDATE workspaces SET clone_status='failed', clone_error=<err.Error()>, updated_at=<now>

subtasks.title: Implement archive handler git push and SHA recording for ready workspaces
details: In internal/workspace/handler_archive.go, after existing auth/state checks, branch on clone_status

If clone_status='ready': call git.PlainOpen(<workspaceRoot>/<slug>/trunk); call repo.Push(&git.PushOptions{RemoteName: "origin"}); if err != nil && err != git.NoErrAlreadyUpToDate, return HTTP 500 with error message
On push success: call repo.Head() then .Hash().String() to get head_sha; call os.RemoveAll(<workspaceRoot>/<slug>)
UPDATE workspaces SET clone_status='archived', head_sha=<sha>, status='archived', updated_at=<now>

subtasks.title: Implement archive rejection for cloning state and cleanup for pending/failed
details: If clone_status='cloning': return HTTP 409 with JSON error body containing message 'clone in progress; try again after it completes'

If clone_status='pending' or 'failed': call os.RemoveAll(<workspaceRoot>/<slug>) to clean up any partial directory (ignore not-exist errors); UPDATE workspaces SET clone_status='archived', status='archived', updated_at=<now>
Return HTTP 200 with updated workspace response in all success cases
